summary: Implement independent persistent write owner for Agora domain (services/agora/store.py, service.py, write_authority.py) backed by PostgresJsonOwnerStore across Agora tables (sessions, memos, evidence_packs, notes, insights, training_examples, signals, signal_feedback, feedback, handoffs, audit_events, journal_entries, journal_audit, journal_idempotency, workshops, proposals, interactions) with owner_service='agora-svc'. Enforce role-based write authority matrix across all Agora resources with fail-closed 403 AgoraWriteForbiddenError. Zero read_store or in-memory dictionary overlay imports in services/agora/. Write-then-fresh-read verified across distinct store instances. Source Ingestion verified reconcile-only. Zero changes to services/control-plane/bff/main.py.

criterion_1_independent_persistent_owner.details: AgoraStore and AgoraWriteService implement dedicated domain write owners using PostgresJsonOwnerStore across all Agora tables with owner_service='agora-svc'.

criterion_2_no_read_store_import.details: AST-verified zero imports or references to read_store or bff_local_dev_store in services/agora/.

criterion_3_write_then_fresh_read_proof.details: Tested cross-instance mutation and immediate fresh read retrieval across separate store instances with zero in-memory caching or dictionary overlays.

criterion_5_source_ingestion_reconcile_o.details: AST-verified that services/source_ingestion/ has zero write mutations on Agora stores and remains strictly reconcile-only.
